open_threads: After the 59th session concludes on 10 July 2026, does the A/CN.9-series session report record adoption, referral back, or noting of A/CN.9/1246 — and can the unverified companion comments-compilation and agenda document numbers be confirmed against retrieved sources?

Does any State adopting the Protocol/MIIR opt to apply the early-dismissal provisions to pre-existing treaties, which would for the first time give a harmonised jurisdictional-gate tool to IP-investment respondents?
Can the opt-in / non-retroactivity architecture be confirmed against the body of A/CN.9/1246 itself rather than inferred from the Transparency Convention precedent?
Does an accessible primary source for the Hela Schwarz data-exclusivity award emerge, given the ICSID paywall has so far blocked the full text?
Is there any new signal on the Einarsson award beyond the prior baseline of post-hearing briefing through August 2025?
Can an accessible Swedish primary source for Okuashvili be located rather than a paywalled-only confirmation?
